title.en: ice skating at margarethen, after work.
title.de: schlittschuhlaufen im margarethen, nach der arbeit.

line.en: the margarethen rink is open monday 10:00 to 22:00 in the winter season, running since 31 october. the eis-disco season starts saturday 28 november; a weeknight is quieter.
line.de: die kunsteisbahn margarethen ist montags 10 bis 22 uhr offen, seit 31. oktober in der wintersaison. die eis-disco-saison beginnt am 28. november; unter der woche ist es ruhiger.
line.tr: margarethen buz pisti pazartesi 10:00 ile 22:00 arası açık; kış sezonu 31 ekim'den beri sürüyor. eis-disco sezonu 28 kasım'da başlıyor; hafta içi daha sakin.

sparks.why: Kunsteisbahn Margarethen regular hours Mon 10:00-22:00 in the winter season from 31 Oct; Eis-Disco season from 28 Nov (bs.ch ice rink media releases).
